name: onboarding-plan
description: Design an onboarding plan for engineers / designers / PMs joining a team. Structured phases (pre-day-1 / day-1 / week-1 / month-1 / month-3), scope (access + environment + context + first contributions + ramp-up checkpoints), buddy + mentor roles, knowledge-sharing artifacts (team API, architecture walk, onboarding wiki), feedback loops (30/60/90 check-ins), DEI + accessibility considerations, onboarding-health metrics. Outputs reusable template + first-hire-specific plan.
